newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portucel sales steady in November.
newsitem.headline: Portucel sales steady in November.

text.p: Sales of Portuguese pulp group Portucel Industrial-Empresa Produtora de Celulose were steady in November, said Vitor Coelho, director of Portucel.

"From our side, sales in November stayed the same as in previous months," Coelho told Reuters, commenting on news that North American/Scandinavian Norscan pulp inventories rose by 185,000 tonnes in November.
"Our main markets, the producers of fine paper, have had strong output, and are independent of the increase in Norscan stocks," he added.
Portucel shares fell on Lisbon bourse on news of the increase in Norscan pulp inventories. Portucel shares stood at 900 escudos, down 15, in volume of 115,840 shares at 1520 GMT.
